# Portugal Golf Society

> The Portugal Golf Society (PGS) is a Lisbon-based golf society for golfers living in or visiting Portugal, established in 2026. It runs regular society rounds, Stableford competitions, a season-long Order of Merit, society days and clubhouse socials. Golfers of every ability can apply to join through the form at https://www.portugalgolfsociety.com/#join.

The society describes itself as "serious about golf, not too serious about ourselves". It is built around the people as much as the scores: welcoming new arrivals to Portugal and long-time residents alike, and celebrating competition, performance, friendship, bad shots, socialising and life in Portugal.

## Key facts

- Name: Portugal Golf Society (PGS)
- Type: amateur golf society / golf club community
- Based in: Lisbon, Portugal
- Established: 2026
- Plays: courses in and around Lisbon, plus society days elsewhere in Portugal
- Format: society rounds scored in Stableford, competitions, Order of Merit
- Who can join: golfers of any handicap, expats and Portuguese residents; run in English
- How to join: https://www.portugalgolfsociety.com/#join (name, email, optional phone/WhatsApp, handicap, location)
- Also known as / searched for: golf society Portugal, Lisbon golf society, Portuguese golf society, expat golf society Portugal, golf group Lisbon, golf club for expats in Portugal, sociedade de golfe Portugal, grupo de golfe Lisboa

## FAQ

- What is the Portugal Golf Society? A Lisbon-based golf society for golfers in Portugal, with regular rounds, competitions and socials.
- How do I join a golf society in Portugal? Use the join form at https://www.portugalgolfsociety.com/#join and the society will be in touch about the next round.
- Is there a golf society in Lisbon? Yes, the Portugal Golf Society is based in Lisbon.
- Do I need a handicap? No; all abilities are welcome.
- Is it for expats? It welcomes expats and Portuguese golfers alike, and is run in English.
